high_level_description: This image captures the facade of a building at night, illuminated by artificial lighting that highlights its architectural details. The building has a warm, earthy color palette with a pinkish hue on the main section and a yellow border around the windows and balcony railing. The roof is dark, possibly tiled, and there's a small overhang above the windows. The windows are rectangular with black shutters, and they are evenly spaced across the facade. The balcony below the windows features ornate black wrought-iron railings, adding an elegant touch to the structure.
